_comment: Measurements taken on the SHIPPED projects/tokyodrift2006/final.mp4 (144.8 MB, 2026-10-29 16:29) - the render that was watched and reported as defective. Every threshold added in this series is sited against these numbers rather than against a rule of thumb, so a bar can be checked against the defect it was written to catch. All timestamps are OUTPUT positions in the finished file.

file.note: The container header reports the LONGEST stream, which is why the file looked correct. The picture is ABSENT from 4:15.77 to 17:34.47 - 798.70s, 13m18.70s - and every player holds the last frame over it. freezedetect reported the film clean because it scanned only the 255s of frames that exist.

intro_freezes_reported_by_gate.note: All four fall inside the prepended intro block, so all four were built by pipeline/intro.py, whose tpad was uncapped. Independently corroborated here: a frame sampled at t=20s of this file is entirely black (mean luma 0.0 across the row at y=540), while frames at 80s, 150s and 220s show normal content inside a 132px letterbox.

film_speaks_bar_note: FILM_SPEAKS_MARGIN_MIN_DB was first written as 3.0 dB, which line 110 would have PASSED at +3.2 dB - a check calibrated to accept the render it was written to catch. Raised to 10.0 dB, which is reachable inside the 20 dB duck.
music_cue_note: 5 of 6 cues lifted under 3 dB where the configured intent was +10 dB (+14 for action). Cause: the cue source files' own integrated loudness spans 9.0 dB (action1 -3.5 LUFS to sad1 -12.5), which is larger than the gain differences the mix is built on, so a relative gain meant something different for every cue.

film_audio_stem_presence.measured_by: normalised cross-correlation of the finished mix against stems/no_vocals.wav, 4s windows
film_audio_stem_presence.note: Both groups are above the absent-bar, i.e. the stem played under every line. Level could not have detected this: on a control mix, adding a stem at -17 dB moved RMS by 0.3-0.4 dB while moving correlation from 0.006 to 0.270.

shared_footage.note: Declared windows abut exactly and do not overlap. Line 101 is a 6.0s hold in a 5.52s window, and _build_silence_clip reads the authored hold straight from the source with no -t, so it really reached 0.48s into line 100's footage. Resolved by widening 101's window to 5.94s and shortening the hold to match.

repeat_scene_scan.coverage_note: Only 255.8s of video exists in this file, so this scan covers 4:15 of a 17:34 film. It is NOT evidence that the full render is free of repeated scenes - the remaining 13m19s has no frames to examine.
